_comment: schematic points at the new KiCad 9 design under mcuc_inverter/, so ERC runs on every check. board stays null until a .kicad_pcb exists. The 2017 boards under pcb_design/ and 'adaptor boards/' are KiCad 4 legacy format (EESchema Schematic File Version 2) and are deliberately out of scope -- copperhead only edits modern s-expression files and must not touch them. Model and endpoint live in .env (machine-specific).
